title: Ombudsman Remulla: 39 cases already filed over flood control mess

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman has already filed 39 cases in connection with the flood control scandal, according to Ombudsman Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla. Remulla bared this as he delivered his first annual report on Monday. Of the 39 flood control cases, Remulla said 35 were filed before the Sandiganbayan and four in the regional trial courts. Remulla also emphasized that 52 individuals, including high-ranking officials, such as former House Speaker Martin Romualdez and Senator Jinggoy Estrada, were facing charges due to the flood control mess.
